command.unknown: ❓ Unknown command: {command}. Use !help to see the list.
help.afk: !afk — Toggle AFK (spectator without losing your queue spot).
help.queue: !queue — Shows your position in the waiting queue.
help.kick: !kick <id|name> — Kicks a player from the room.
help.mute: !mute <id|name> — Toggles chat mute for a player.
help.priority: !priority <id|name> — Adds or removes players from your priority list; listed players are placed on your team in reshuffles. Use !priority list to view it and !priority clear to empty it.
afk.enabled: 💤 You are AFK. You stay in the queue as a spectator and will not enter the field.
afk.disabled: ✅ You are no longer AFK. You will enter the field when a spot opens according to your queue position.
mod.noPermission: 🚫 You do not have permission to use this command.
mod.ambiguous: ❓ Multiple players match. Be more specific.
mod.targetProtected: 🚫 You cannot moderate a room admin.
mute.blocked: 🔇 You are muted and cannot talk.
priority.usage: ℹ️ Usage: !priority <id|name> adds or removes that player from your list · !priority list shows your list · !priority clear empties it.
priority.enabled: 🤝 Priority added: {name} will be placed on your team in reshuffles.
priority.disabled: 🔓 Priority removed: {name} is no longer on your list.
match.welcome: 👋 Welcome, {name}! Type !help to see the available commands.
match.waitingForPlayers: ⏳ Players are uneven; you'll return to the field as soon as another player can join the opposite team.
match.teamsFull: 🪑 Teams are full; you'll enter the field as soon as a spot opens up.
match.afkWarning: ⚠️ You will be kicked for inactivity in {seconds}...
match.mapPending: 🗺️ Pending switch to {map}. It will apply on the next natural pause (goal).
match.teamsReshuffled: 🏁 Match over. Teams reshuffled at random.
queue.position: 📍 Your position in the queue is #{position}.
queue.onField: ⚽ You are on the field, you are not in the queue.
queue.afk: 💤 You are AFK and do not hold a spot in the waiting queue. Use !afk to come back.
